subject.title: Feature: Add costCurrency config option to customize cost display currency

question: Should OpenClaw add a public local-cost currency contract, and if so should currency live on model pricing entries, provider defaults, a global default, or remain USD-only?
rationale: The request is not a broken existing contract; it adds config and changes cost-accounting semantics across persisted estimates, status output, the Usage UI, and docs.

options.title: Design local pricing currency metadata
options.body: Add currency metadata where local model pricing is defined and carry it through all estimate surfaces with USD as the default and provider billing units kept separate.

options.title: Keep local estimates USD-only
options.body: Decline the new config surface and clarify that local `models.providers.*.models[].cost` estimates are USD while provider-reported billing can show native units.

options.title: Fold into broader status customization
options.body: Treat this as part of the broader customizable footer/status work rather than changing cost-accounting fields now.

recommendation.title: Design local pricing currency metadata
recommendation.body: Add currency metadata where local model pricing is defined and carry it through all estimate surfaces with USD as the default and provider billing units kept separate.
